No consent recording, sample, clone or cloneVoiceLive adapter exists.

Final test, typecheck, build and browser totals remain pending the root verification update. Earlier aggregate counts are historical and must not be presented as the final result; no competitor-superiority claim is established.

After removing the orphaned generated Next.js validator file left by an interrupted run, the production server started and rendered Agents. Responsive browser checks at 1280, 611 and 390 pixels found no horizontal overflow; fresh visual review remains pending and no ship claim is made.

The bounded browser call ran for 92 seconds with a real greeting, three typed turns, Hinglish responses and seven transcript entries. The exact opening wording was not fully obeyed and one early reply bunched two requested fields; voice-quality follow-up remains needed.

Browser inspection observed repair moving open to repairing to repaired across distinct caller confirmations. Saved preview Conversations confirm four server-recomputed state changes including Hinglish and repaired state. Context records contain no raw transcript or customer data.

Gmail and Microsoft Graph OAuth refresh/callback paths require user client application IDs and secrets for real accounts. Email is explicit per-recipient durable accepted/rejected/uncertain delivery with no automatic uncertain resend; WhatsApp is check-only and telephone is deferred. The prior bounded 105-test pass remains historical. Root's full test and browser LIVE verification of the major implementation pass is pending; no final count, new external OAuth connection, real outbound email send, or ship claim is recorded. Existing Maya/Azure voice evidence remains valid.

Root verification passed 196 tests with 0 failures; build and typecheck passed. A minor visual refinement gate remains after the first fresh capture found source overflow, duplicated campaign forms and an oversized Quality Lab; no whole-product ship claim is made.

Grounded Q&A returned two exact citations and reused a cached repeat. Campaign binding/digest and an internal outcome were recorded.

A PII guard blocked company publication, operator correction created a canonical customer without consent, and source/customer-directory epoch guards protected writes. Evidence Lab preserved one contradictory raw verdict and only reviewed verdicts enter comparison; no human listening or competitor trial was claimed.

OAuth authorization-version health checks and refresh preserve queues while manual authorization, account switch or scope loss invalidates them. A local signed webhook returned 202 for valid input, 200 with accepted:false for a duplicate and 401 for a bad signature. Seven completed text requests recorded 6576 tokens; voice charges were excluded and no pricing or billing claim was made. No real external connect, sync or email send was verified.
